name: Elemental Bracers
objectiveText: Collect 5 Intact Elemental Bracers and use the Divining Scroll on them. Afterwards, bring the Divined Scroll to Sentinel Velene Starstrike at the Silverwind Refuge. Divined Scroll  ( 1 ) Intact Elemental Bracer  ( 5 )

comments.body: The bracers drop off the water elementals in the lake right behind the outpost where you get he quest. The bracers you need are the 'intact' ones. The other bracers are vendor trash. After you have collected 5 intact bracers then you right click on the scroll and left click on the stack of 5 intact bracers. If you dont have a scroll then I would abandon the quest and start all over to get the scroll again. Once you have used the scroll on the bracers you'll need to go back to the quest giver to get the next part of the quest.(and get your exp)

I don't know if drop rates of the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=12220/intact-elemental-bracer]Intact Elemental Bracers[/url] were changed since Vanilla WoW, but these things take forever to drop. Took me ~20 [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=3917/befouled-water-elemental]Befouled Water Elementals[/url] to get my first intact one, yet reading the comments I keep seeing people say they got all 5 bracers in like 6 kills. Just putting this out there because I was kinda confused at first and wanted to clarify for any more recent players on this page.

comments.body: Location: Ashenvale, Mystral Lake 47,70

Head south of this location to the little island in the lake. You'll find the mobs here. You can clearly see the bracers on their arms. In the center of the island is a lvl 27 so watch out. Once you return the (5) bracers you may notice like I did and a few others that the Diving Scroll is not in your possession as it says it should be. If this happens to you, simply abandon the quest and pick it up again. The bracers will still be in your inventory and you can immediately get the scroll and bind them.

You get a scroll when taking this quest, you must then kill the water elementals in and around the lake that you got the quest and collect 5 'Intact Elemental Bracers' then right click the scroll and take back to the npc.

I got all 5 with about 8 kills, real easy! :)

The only bracers you need are 'Intact Bracers' as these are the quest items. They are gold. The other ones ie. fractured bracer etc. are all just rubbish.

When youve got 5 intact bracer, use the scroll in your inventory from the quest giver. Just right click on the scroll, then hand quest in!
coords are 48,68 in Ashenvale

Ok, I don't understand why everyone finds this quest so difficult. First off, the locs of the enemies that drop the Intact Elemental Bracers are 48,71. They have a drop rate of roughly 20-25% for those. Than, you head back to 50,66 and right click on the scroll which you have in your inventory, which turns into the one for the quest. The sentinel gives you a "Divining Scroll".  Once you've collected the 5 bracers, use this and it and the 5 bracers are replaced by a "Divined Scroll" that you can finish the quest with.

I had the same problem. I didn't recieve the scroll. Abandoned and retook the quest, several times. No luck. 

So I forgot about it, ran around, did my thing. A little later I used a Scroll of Protection I'd been carrying around, and noticed about an hour later that the Divining Scroll had just appeared in my backpack. 

So if you have any scrolls *other than* the divining scroll, try to store or use them and see if that helps.

I've done this quest on 3 or 4 characters, always took forever to get the bracers.  Not only did the drop rate always seem pretty dang low to me, there's also a level 27 named in the lake which manages to track you down regularly and kicks your behind. The quest reward of that quest line (Light of Elune) is very useful though.

These drop off the elementals in the lake directly east of Silverwind Refuge. The only thing you have to be aware of is Tideress, a level 27 mob who roams the island in the middle of the lake.

The regular elementals range from 23-25. You can get them on the north side of the lake, in the lake, or the island in the middle of the lake. The intact bracers seemed to drop about once every three kills. You can also get damaged bracers, but these don't count for the quest.

This quest is nice because the NPC you get it from/return to is so close to where you kill the mobs.
